verdict.rationale: Pigment is a SaaS planning platform with built-in AI agents, so a training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no statement about whether customer data is used for model training, and no opt-out control. The only related items are adjacent controls (regional data residency, fine-grained access rights, admin approval of assistant connections), and these do not address AI training use.
